focused_cautions: Train: score zero requires interior first-order conditions and is not globally equivalent to MLE; moment orthogonality is weaker than independence; general simulation consistency/CLTs need uniformity, rate and identification conditions. A Jensen log bias is not automatically the same as estimator bias.
Train reciprocal-probability product unbiasedness needs independent simulation streams or a justified covariance argument; inspect actual equation context before recording a finding.

Rust1987 empirical model must not be treated as a universal identification/consistency theorem. Distinguish normalized utility/shock scale and maintained transition/discount assumptions. Verify physical versus printed pagination (PDF appears to include a cover).
Indirect inference: local full-rank derivative is not global injectivity; finite simulation draws and sample size limits are separate; avoid adopting general dependent-data CLTs without assumptions.
